dialogues.jp:
眞子の号令とともにＨＲが終わり、教室内は一
気にざわめきに包まれる。
dialogues.en:
On Mako's order and with the end of HR, the class was
engulfed in noise.
dialogues.text:
On Mako's order and with the end of HR, the class was
engulfed in noise.

dialogues.jp:
話題はもっぱら、明日の試験についてだ。頭の
いい奴の周りには、何人か取り巻きがついてい
たりもする。
dialogues.en:
The main topic was, of course, tomorrow's exams. All the
smart ones were immediately surrounded by the others for
advice.
dialogues.text:
The main topic was, of course, tomorrow's exams. All the
smart ones were immediately surrounded by the others for
advice.

dialogues.jp:
それ以外の連中は、さっさと教室を出て行って
しまう。｛さすが／流石｝に今日は、みな勉強をするのだろ
う。
dialogues.en:
The rest of my classmates quickly left the classroom. As
expected, today's a long studying period for everyone.
dialogues.text:
The rest of my classmates quickly left the classroom. As
expected, today's a long studying period for everyone.

dialogues.jp:
眞子の号令で放課後がやってきた。教室内は明
日の試験の話題で持ちきりだ。頭のいい奴のと
こに集まったり、さっさと帰宅したり……。
dialogues.en:
Mako's order ended the school day. The classroom was filled
with chatter about the coming exams. They either surrounded
the smart ones, or went straight home.
